# EnumIndex2col

A long list shown as a complete set.

## When to use it

Ten to sixteen offerings have to be seen as a whole, where the breadth is the point rather than any one item.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | B-enumeration (secondary structural) |
| Form | index |
| Arity | 16 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | standard, about 620 characters |
| Media | none |
| Focal | title at 64px against a 64px headline (ratio 1.0) |

## Why it holds together

Flat throughout. Sixteen peers on one slide cannot have a hero without lying about the set.

## Related kit layout

`ColumnsV2` — ColumnsV2 tops out at four items. At sixteen a bulleted list reads as a wall.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| title and timing note collide | set on the same baseline and print through each other | three tiers | A defect in the source. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.

## Origin

# EnumNumbered4

Numbered method steps across a ground change.

## When to use it

Three or four named stages, each needing a sentence of substance rather than a label.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | B-enumeration |
| Form | numbered |
| Arity | 3 |
| Ground | cream, white |
| Density | standard, about 505 characters |
| Media | none |
| Focal | ordinal at 192px against a 64px headline (ratio 3.0) |

## Why it holds together

The reason this is not the same template as a numbered column list with a small ordinal. Bank slides 86 and 103 share family, form and near-arity and are compositionally opposite purely on this ratio: 86 runs 3.0, 103 runs 0.5 and the numeral becomes a label. No skeleton axis separates them.

## Related kit layout

`ColumnsV5` — ColumnsV5 covers the same content signal and loses the device: no ground change, numerals at an inline-overridden 120px in Thin, and the lower third of the canvas unused. Do not retire it until this template has been through a real deck.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| content edge | 61 | 40 | RESOLVED in the frame-constants commit, but not to the measured 61. The brand playbook's Layout page states it literally for this exact canvas: 'Our most used format uses 40px square grid using 40px margins and 40px column space.' Brand-declared beats measured practice, so --m-edge is 40 and MAP's deeper text edge is available as --m-text:56px when a column of running copy needs it. |
| headline size | 64 | 54 | STILL OPEN. 64px is the 32pt source at the corrected x2 factor; the shell's 54px descends from the old x1.5. Rescaling the whole type scale is a bigger judgement than a frame constant and wants the tracer plus a human eye, so it was deliberately left out of the frame commit. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.
